newsitem.title: USA: Super-Sol files ADS offering with SEC.
newsitem.headline: Super-Sol files ADS offering with SEC.

text.p: Super-Sol Ltd, Israel's largest supermarket chain, filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register an offering of American Depositary shares, each representing five ordinary shares.
A portion of the shares will be offered overseas.
The Petah Tikva, Israel-based company did not disclose the size of the offering.
Underwriters for the offering, Goldman Sachs & Co, Prudential Securities Inc and UBS Securities LLC, will underwrite the offering.
Super-Sol said it plans to use $50 million of the net proceeds from the sale to help fund its expansion plans. Proceeds will also be used to reduce outstanding bank debt, according to the SEC filing.
The company said it will apply to have the American depositary shares listed on the New York Stock Exchange.
